opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 424 U. S. 907.] Motions of respondents for' leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motions for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that John W. Walker, Esquire, of Moscow, Idaho, serve as counsel for respondents Leonard Francis Davison and William Andrew Davison, and that *893Allen. V. Bowles, Esquire, of Moscow, Idaho, serve as counsel for respondent Antelope in this case.
